formula: score = min(100, data_class_subtotal + scale_mod + remediation_gap_mod + notification_lag_mod)

data_class_subtotal.description: Sum of the severity weights of every exposed data class, capped at 70.

scale_modifier.description: Log-scaled on records_affected. Bands are inclusive of their lower bound, exclusive of their upper bound. Unknown records_affected scores 0 and is flagged in the breakdown.

remediation_gap_modifier.description: Scores the gap between what was exposed and what the entity offered. The spec defines: none offered = 10, under 12 months = 5, 24 months or more = 0. The 12-23 month band, unspecified in the source spec, is set to 2 in rubric v1.0.

notification_lag_modifier.description: Days between discovery_date and notification_date. Unknown dates score 0 and are flagged in the breakdown.

rendering_rule: Always display the score with its component breakdown and the rubric version. A bare number with no math shown reads as invented.
